fails.where: h1#title "เชื่อมต่อระบบไม่ได้"
fails.msg: the first screen holds no number, price, date, place, platform or genre
fails.fix: put one hard fact from the brief on the first screen: a number, a price, a date, the place, the platforms it runs on or a game's genre; take it from the brief or remove the claim
wheres: h1#title "เชื่อมต่อระบบไม่ได้"

fails.msg: "div:where(.swal2-container) div:where(.swal2-popup):focus" in the page removes the focus outline and sets nothing in its place
fails.fix: keep the kit's :focus-visible ring, or put a change of the same strength (a 2px line in --action) in the rule that removes it
wheres: div:where(.swal2-container) div:where(.swal2-popup):focus

fails.msg: a software page (--type) deals no moment: every kind carries one, two on a long page (moments.md)
fails.fix: deal one (moments.mjs pick --page software) and mount it in its own section
wheres: (the page)

wheres: main#access-content > section.workspace.wrap "ระบบหน้าร้านสหกรณ์เชื่อมต่อระบบไม่ได้ติด"

warns.where: h1#title "เชื่อมต่อระบบไม่ได้"
warns.msg: "เชื่อมต่อระบบไม่ได้": no category known to check it against (pass --category, or write the <title> as "Name: what it is for whom")
warns.fix: put the category noun in the h1 (and who it is for, or where), in 2 to 8 words

warns.where: section.workspace.wrap > div.access-form > div.form-actions > button.button.button-ghost "เปลี่ยนที่อยู่เซิร์ฟเวอร์"
warns.msg: the button "เปลี่ยนที่อยู่เซิร์ฟเวอร์" (#ffffff) stands only 1.00:1 off the ground around it: it reads as part of the ground, or as switched off
warns.fix: give the button a fill that stands at least 1.5:1 off what is around it, or an outline in the ink

warns.where: div#root > div.app-shell > a.skip-link "ข้ามไปแบบฟอร์ม"
warns.msg: the first Tab stop is "ข้ามไปแบบฟอร์ม", not a skip link: a keyboard user tabs through the whole nav on every visit
warns.fix: add the starter's skip link as the header's first child: Skip to content

warns.msg: the head lacks og:title, og:description, og:image, twitter:card, an icon: a shared link shows no picture or title of its own
warns.fix: copy the head block of starter.html: og tags, twitter:card, the icon and theme-color (references/system.md, Head)
